rule_yaml:
rules:
  - id: dubbo-npe-c1-r2
    languages:
      - java
    severity: ERROR
    message: >-
      A possibly-null value is dereferenced without a null guard: the URL
      component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain
      URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()) or the result of a nullable
      service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo(), which
      return null when no matching ServiceInfo exists). The unguarded
      dereference throws a NullPointerException. Guard the value before using
      it, e.g. if (x == null) return ...; / if (x != null) { ... } /
      x == null ? ... : x.method().
    paths:
      exclude:
        - "**/src/test/**"
        - "**/test/**"
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
          # (A) nullable service-info lookup result dereferenced directly
          - pattern: getServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          - pattern: getValidServiceInfo(...).$M(...)
          # (B) nullable lookup result stored in a local, then dereferenced
          #     without any null guard (early return / if / ternary forms)
          - patterns:
              - pattern-inside: |
                  $TYPE $SI = $LOOKUP(...);
                  ...
              - metavariable-regex:
                  metavariable: $LOOKUP
                  regex: "(getServiceInfo|getValidServiceInfo)$"
              - pattern: $SI.$M(...)
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null == $SI ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI == null ...>) return $X;
                  ...
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... null != $SI ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... $SI != null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: "null == $SI ? $A : $SI.$M(...)"
              - pattern-not-inside: "$SI == null ? $A : $SI.$M(...)"
              - pattern-not-inside: "null != $SI ? $SI.$M(...) : $A"
              - pattern-not-inside: "$SI != null ? $SI.$M(...) : $A"
          # (C) URL component field 'urlAddress' dereferenced unconditionally
          - patterns:
              - pattern-either:
                  - pattern: |
                      $T $V = urlAddress.$M(...);
                      return $R($V);
                  - pattern: |
                      return urlAddress.$M(...);
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress == null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (<... urlAddress != null ...>) {
                      ...
                  }
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress == null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  urlAddress != null ? $A : $B
              - pattern-not-inside: |
                  if (...) {
                      ...
                  }
commonality: A possibly-null value — the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()) or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo()) — is dereferenced with no null check, so the delegation throws a NullPointerException; guard it with a null check, early return, or ternary before use.
message: A possibly-null value is dereferenced without a null guard: the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()) or the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo(), which return null when no matching ServiceInfo exists). The unguarded dereference throws a NullPointerException. Guard the value before using it, e.g. if (x == null) return ...; / if (x != null) { ... } / x == null ? ... : x.method().
